verses.text: “Don’t let your heart get shaken up. Trust God, and trust me too.
There are many rooms in my Father’s house. If that weren’t true, I would have told you. I’m going there to prepare a place for you.
And if I go prepare a place for you, I’ll come back and bring you to be with me, so you can be where I am.
You know where I’m going, and you know the way.”
Thomas said, “Lord, we don’t know where you’re going. So how can we know the way?”
Jesus told him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.
If you had known me, you would have known my Father too. From now on, you do know him and have seen him.”
Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father. That will be enough for us.”
Jesus answered, “Philip, I’ve been with you all this time, and you still don’t know me? Whoever has seen me has seen the Father. So why ask, ‘Show us the Father’?
Don’t you believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words I speak aren’t from me alone. The Father who lives in me is doing his work.
Believe me when I say I am in the Father and the Father is in me. If you can’t, believe because of the works themselves.
I’m telling you the truth: whoever believes in me will do the works I do. They’ll do even greater works, because I’m going to the Father.
Whatever you ask in my name, I’ll do it, so the Father may be glorified through the Son.
If you ask anything in my name, I will do it.
If you love me, keep my commands.
I’ll ask the Father, and he’ll give you another Advocate to stay with you forever:
the Spirit of truth. The world can’t receive him, because it doesn’t see him or know him. You know him, because he lives with you and will be in you.
I won’t leave you like orphans. I will come to you.
Soon the world won’t see me anymore, but you will see me. Because I live, you will live too.
When that day comes, you’ll know that I am in my Father, you are in me, and I am in you.
Whoever has my commands and keeps them is the one who loves me. My Father will love whoever loves me, and I will love them and show myself to them.”
Judas—not Judas Iscariot—said to him, “Lord, what’s going on? Why are you about to show yourself to us and not to the world?”
Jesus answered, “Anyone who loves me will keep my word. My Father will love them, and we will come to them and make our home with them.
Whoever doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The message you hear isn’t mine; it comes from the Father who sent me.
I’ve told you all this while I’m still here with you.
But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you everything and remind you of all I’ve told you.
I leave you peace; I give you my peace. I don’t give it the way the world gives. Don’t let your heart be troubled or afraid. 🕊️
You heard me say, ‘I’m going away, and I’ll come back to you.’ If you loved me, you’d be glad I’m going to the Father, because the Father is greater than I am.
I’ve told you this before it happens, so when it does happen, you’ll believe.
I won’t be talking with you much longer, because the ruler of this world is coming. He has no claim on me.
But the world must know that I love the Father. I do exactly what the Father commanded me. Get up—let’s go from here.
